title: Ricardo Gill — AI training and evaluation
author: Ricardo Gill
research_status: Direct methodological fit; benefits require controlled evaluation

finder_profile.audience: AI training and evaluation researchers, developers and evaluators
finder_profile.required_capability: Read original sources, design controlled tests, retain provenance and distinguish proposals from findings.

possible_application: Develop examples that distinguish historical actor knowledge from later evidence and separate desired outcomes from verified achievement. Compare the same model and evidence with and without Gill instructions.
illustrative_example: A release decision predates a later technical report. Train the model to use that report for retrospective explanation without attributing it to the decision maker.
evaluation_targets: Temporal leakage, actor-access accuracy, provenance fidelity, false completion and appropriate abstention.
requested_contribution: Read, test, adapt or critique the authored research; report methods, source version, comparisons, results and limitations.
source_relation: Related sources establish background problems or methods, not independent validation or endorsement of GCI.
